checks.finding: T08 epsilon(theta) is detection/selection efficiency under injections, not echo amplitude.
T08 alpha(Lambda) is per-reading selection normalization, not a coupling constant.
GWTC3 Table IV reports cutoff frequency and split SNR for selected O3b events, not GR full-IMR MAP posterior samples.
Primary GWTC3 and GWTC4 IMRCT papers use >6 for each part; >=8 is a stricter order input, not the cited LVK IMRCT rule.
Displayed first SNR equality inserts a redundant quotient undefined when (h|d)=0; expected waveform norm and observed matched-filter projection also have distinct roles.
Time/f220 alternatives and an echo template were invented outside the T08 prescribed source convention; sqrt(beta) echo route is dead in ORDEM016.
A remnant mass/spin median cannot substitute for full binary MAP parameters in an accepted 74-event table.
